name: eve-lead-intake-agent
description: Workspace for @eve-lead-intake/core, @eve-lead-intake/eve and the example lead intake agent.

scripts.build:eve: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @eve-lead-intake/eve
scripts.build: npm run build:eve && npm run build -w lead-intake-agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck -w @eve-lead-intake/core && npm run typecheck -w @eve-lead-intake/eve && npm run typecheck -w lead-intake-agent
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w lead-intake-agent
